exercises.instructionEn: Match the pictures with their meanings.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI BELGI (A-F):

  A  Chizib tashlangan SIGARET
  B  Chizib tashlangan 'P' harfi
  C  'SPEED LIMIT 30' yozuvli to'rtburchak belgi
  D  Chizib tashlangan ChAPGA burilish strelkasi
  E  Chizib tashlangan JO'MRAK va PIYOLA
  F  Chizib tashlangan FOTOAPPARAT


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Don't drink the water.  →  E
  2  Don't park here.        →  B
  3  Don't take pictures.    →  F
  4  Don't turn left.        →  D
  5  Don't smoke.            →  A
  6  Don't drive fast.       →  C


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  SIGARET     →  smoke      (chekmoq)
  'P' harfi   →  park       (mashina qo'ymoq)
  30 raqami   →  drive fast (tez haydamoq)
  ChAP strelka →  turn left  (chapga burilmoq)
  JO'MRAK     →  drink water (suv ichmoq)
  FOTOAPPARAT →  take pictures (suratga olmoq)


DIQQAT — 'P' HARFI:
  Butun dunyoda 'P' = PARKING (avtoturargoh).
  Chizib tashlangan 'P' = 'NO PARKING'
  (mashina qo'yish taqiqlanadi).

  Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialog:
  'Can I park here?' — 'No, you can't. You
   mustn't park here — it's illegal.'


DIQQAT — 'SPEED LIMIT 30':
  Bu belgi TAQIQ emas, ChEGARA ko'rsatadi:
  soatiga 30 (mil yoki km) dan tez
  haydamaslik.

  Shuning uchun ma'nosi: 'Don't drive fast.'

  'a speed limit' = tezlik chegarasi
  Bu — to'rtburchak shaklidagi yagona belgi
  (qolganlari doira).


DIQQAT — 'E' BELGISI:
  Jo'mrak va piyola chizib tashlangan =
  bu suvni IChIB BO'LMAYDI.

  Bunday belgi ko'p mamlakatlarda
  jamoat joylaridagi jo'mraklarda turadi.

  Yozuv shakli: 'NOT DRINKING WATER' yoki
  'NON-POTABLE WATER'.


GRAMMAR BOOK 61-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda ham xuddi shunday mashq bor edi:
     Don't throw rubbish / walk / ride your
     bike / turn right / enter / touch

  Bu yerda BOShQA oltita:
     Don't drink the water / park / take
     pictures / turn left / smoke / drive fast

  Faqat 'turn' takrorlangan:
     Grammar 61: turn RIGHT
     Workbook 57: turn LEFT


BELGILARNI MODAL BILAN AYTISh:
  A  You mustn't smoke here.
  B  You mustn't park here.
  C  You mustn't drive fast.
  D  You mustn't turn left.
  E  You mustn't drink the water.
  F  You mustn't take pictures.

  'mustn't' — chunki bular QONUNIY taqiq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to park         = mashina qo'ymoq
  a speed limit   = tezlik chegarasi
  to turn left    = chapga burilmoq
  to take pictures = suratga olmoq
  to smoke        = chekmoq
  to drive fast   = tez haydamoq

pairs.whyUz:
E belgisida JO'MRAK va PIYOLA chizib
tashlangan — suv ichishga yaroqsiz.

Bunday belgi jamoat joylaridagi jo'mraklarda
turadi.

B belgisida 'P' harfi chizib tashlangan.

Butun dunyoda 'P' = PARKING (avtoturargoh).
Chizilgan 'P' = 'NO PARKING'.

Coursebook 102-bet, 16e:
'You mustn't park here — it's illegal.'

F belgisida FOTOAPPARAT chizib tashlangan.

Bunday belgi muzeylarda, harbiy obyektlarda
turadi.

'to take pictures OF something' — predlog 'of'.
Grammar 62-bet, 5-mashq (hayvonot bog'i):
'Can we take pictures of the animals?'

D belgisida ChAPGA qaragan strelka chizib
tashlangan.

DIQQAT: Grammar 61-betdagi mashqda O'NGGA
burilish belgisi bor edi ('Don't turn right').
Kitob ataylab ikkalasini bergan.

A belgisida SIGARET chizib tashlangan.

Qisqa yozma shakli: 'NO SMOKING'
(DIQQAT: 'No SMOKE' emas, 'No SMOKING' — 
qo'shimcha '-ING' bilan).

Grammar 60-bet: 'You mustn't smoke in
hospitals.'

C belgisida 'SPEED LIMIT 30' yozilgan —
tezlik chegarasi 30.

DIQQAT: bu belgi TAQIQ emas, ChEGARA
ko'rsatadi — lekin ma'nosi 'tez haydamang'.

Bu — TO'RTBURCHAK shaklidagi yagona belgi
(qolganlari doira).

Grammar 63-bet, 9-mashq: 'fastly' XATO,
to'g'risi 'fast'.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAVZU: PREDLOGLAR (Unit 14 dagi turg'un
birikmalar)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  C (for)
  2  C (at)
  3  A (into)
  4  B (with)
  5  A (in)
  6  C (on)
  7  B (by)
  8  A (on)


HAR BIRI — TURG'UN BIRIKMA:

 1  'late FOR appointments'
    'to be late FOR something' — turg'un
    Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy va Angliya
    matnlari: 'Never be late FOR appointments.'

 2  'leave your shoes AT the door'
    'AT the door' = eshik oldida
    Coursebook 100-bet, Yaponiya matni:
    'Leave your shoes AT the door.'

 3  'push INTO a queue'
    'to push INTO' = suqilib kirmoq
    ('into' — ichkariga HARAKAT)
    Coursebook 100-bet, Angliya matni:
    'Never push INTO a queue of people.'

 4  'talk WITH your mouth full'
    'WITH + ot + sifat' — holat qurilmasi
    Coursebook 100-bet:
    'Don't talk WITH your mouth full.'

 5  'kiss IN public'
    'IN public' = odamlar oldida (turg'un,
    artiklsiz)
    Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
    'don't kiss anyone IN public'

 6  'pay the rent ON time'
    'ON time' = o'z vaqtida (turg'un)
    Coursebook 101-bet, 11-mashq jadvali:
    'pay the rent ON time'

 7  'be home BY 11 pm'
    'BY' = ... gacha (oxirgi muddat)
    Coursebook 101-bet va Grammar 60-bet:
    'You must be home BY 11 pm.'

 8  'write ON the desks'
    'ON' = ustiga (yuzaga yozish)
    Coursebook 102-bet, 13a-mashq:
    'You mustn't write ON the walls.'


ENG NOZIK JOYLAR:

  1) 'LATE FOR' — 'late AT/IN' XATO
     Yodda tuting: late FOR school,
     late FOR work, late FOR the party

  3) 'PUSH INTO' — 'push in' emas
     'into' harakat yo'nalishini bildiradi
     ('onto' — yuzaga chiqish, mos emas)

  6) 'ON TIME' va 'IN TIME' FARQI:
     ON time = o'z vaqtida, belgilangan paytda
        'The train arrived ON time.'
     IN time = ulgurib, kech qolmasdan
        'We arrived IN time to see the film.'

  7) 'BY' va 'UNTIL' FARQI:
     BY 11 pm    = 11 GACHA yetib kelish
                   (oxirgi muddat)
     UNTIL 11 pm = 11 GACHA turish
                   (butun vaqt davomida)

     'be home BY 11' ✓ (11 dan kechikmang)
     'be home UNTIL 11' — boshqa ma'no
     (11 gacha uyda turing)


JOY PREDLOGLARI — QISQA JADVAL:
  AT  — aniq nuqta:  at the door, at the bus
                     stop, at home
  IN  — ichida:      in the room, in public,
                     in the street
  ON  — yuzasida:    on the table, on the wall,
                     on the desk
  INTO — ichkariga HARAKAT: push into, go into


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an appointment = belgilangan uchrashuv
  a queue        = navbat
  the rent       = ijara haqi
  a desk         = parta
  Mrs Battersby  = Missis Battersbi
                   (CB 101-betdagi uy egasi)

items.textEn: 1  In China, you should never be late ................ appointments.  A at  B in  C for
items.uz: Xitoyda uchrashuvlarga hech qachon kechikmasligingiz kerak.
items.whyUz:
'to be late FOR something' — TURG'UN birikma.

  late FOR school / work / the party  ✓
  late AT / IN ...                    ✗

Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy va Angliya matnlari:
'Never be late FOR appointments.'

items.textEn: 2  When you visit a Japanese house, leave your shoes ................ the door.  A in  B on  C at
items.uz: Yapon uyiga borganingizda, oyoq kiyimingizni eshik oldida qoldiring.
items.whyUz:
'AT the door' = eshik OLDIDA (aniq nuqta).

'AT' — aniq nuqtani bildiradi:
  at the door, at the bus stop, at home

Coursebook 100-bet, Yaponiya matni:
'Leave your shoes AT the door.'

'in the door' — eshikning ICHIDA (ma'nosiz).

items.textEn: 3  English people don't like it if you push ................ a queue.  A into  B onto  C at
items.whyUz:
'to push INTO a queue' = navbatga SUQILIB
KIRMOQ.

'INTO' — ichkariga HARAKAT.
'onto' — yuzaga chiqish (mos emas).

Coursebook 100-bet, Angliya matni:
'Never push INTO a queue of people or they'll
get angry.'

'queue' o'qilishi /kyu/.

items.textEn: 4  'Don't talk ......... your mouth full,' his mother said.  A at  B with  C about
items.whyUz:
'WITH + ot + SIFAT' — holat qurilmasi:
  with your mouth full
  with your eyes closed
  with the door open

Coursebook 100-bet, Angliya matni:
'Don't talk WITH your mouth full.'

Workbook 56-bet, 1-mashqning 3-bandi ham
shu edi.

items.textEn: 5  In some countries you can't kiss ................ public.  A in  B on  C at
items.uz: Ba'zi mamlakatlarda odamlar oldida o'pish mumkin emas.
items.whyUz:
'IN public' = odamlar oldida — TURG'UN ibora,
ARTIKLSIZ.

  in public  ✓
  on public  ✗
  in THE public — boshqa ma'no

Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
'don't kiss anyone IN public — it's very rude.'

items.textEn: 6  'You must pay the rent ................ time,' said Mrs Battersby.  A at  B for  C on
items.uz: 'Ijara haqini o'z vaqtida to'lashingiz kerak,' dedi Missis Battersbi.
items.whyUz:
'ON time' = o'z vaqtida — TURG'UN ibora.

DIQQAT — 'ON TIME' va 'IN TIME' FARQI:
  ON time = belgilangan paytda
     'The train arrived ON time.'
  IN time = ulgurib, kech qolmasdan
     'We arrived IN time to see the film.'

Coursebook 101-bet, 11-mashq jadvali:
'pay the rent ON time'.
Mrs Battersby — o'sha betdagi uy egasi!

items.textEn: 7  My father said I must be home ................ 11 pm.  A on  B by  C in
items.uz: Dadam kechqurun 11 gacha uyda bo'lishim kerakligini aytdi.
items.whyUz:
'BY 11 pm' = 11 GACHA (oxirgi muddat).

DIQQAT — 'BY' va 'UNTIL' FARQI:
  be home BY 11 pm    = 11 dan KECHIKMASDAN
                        yetib kelish
  stay home UNTIL 11  = 11 gacha uyda TURISH

Coursebook 101-bet va Grammar 60-bet:
'You must be home BY 11 pm.'
(Grammar 60-bet buni 'for RULES' misoli
sifatida bergan.)

items.textEn: 8  The teacher said we mustn't write ................ the desks.  A on  B in  C over
items.whyUz:
'write ON a surface' — YUZAGA yozish.

'ON' — yuzasida:
  on the table, on the wall, on the desk

Coursebook 102-bet, 13a-mashq, 2-o'quvchi:
'You mustn't write ON the walls.'

'a desk' = parta, yozuv stoli.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with should or shouldn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni should yoki shouldn't bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  SHOULD
  2  SHOULDN'T
  3  SHOULD
  4  SHOULD
  5  SHOULDN'T
  6  SHOULD
  7  SHOULD
  8  SHOULDN'T

  Ya'ni: SHOULD — 1, 3, 4, 6, 7 (5 ta)
         SHOULDN'T — 2, 5, 8 (3 ta)


TO'LIQ GAPLAR VA TARJIMASI:

 1  Kevin has a problem with his eyes. He
    SHOULD see an optician.
    (Kevinning ko'zi bilan muammo bor. U
     ko'zoynak ustasiga borishi kerak.)

 2  People SHOULDN'T drop litter in the
    streets.
    (Odamlar ko'chalarga axlat tashlamasligi
     kerak.)

 3  It's cold outside. You SHOULD put on a
    heavy jacket.
    (Tashqarida sovuq. Qalin kurtka
     kiyishingiz kerak.)

 4  You SHOULD look both ways before crossing
    the street.
    (Ko'chadan o'tishdan oldin ikki tomonga
     qarashingiz kerak.)

 5  You SHOULDN'T swim after eating a big meal.
    (Ko'p ovqat yegandan keyin suzmasligingiz
     kerak.)

 6  Michael SHOULD join a gym to lose weight.
    (Maykl vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga
     yozilishi kerak.)

 7  When you are on a bus you SHOULD give your
    seat to older people.
    (Avtobusda bo'lganingizda o'rningizni
     keksalarga berishingiz kerak.)

 8  Children SHOULDN'T talk to strangers.
    (Bolalar notanish odamlar bilan
     gaplashmasligi kerak.)


OLTIN QOIDA:
  Ish FOYDALI/XAVFSIZ    →  SHOULD
  Ish ZARARLI/XAVFLI     →  SHOULDN'T


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  KALIT: 'a PROBLEM with his eyes' —
    muammo bor, demak yordam kerak → SHOULD.
    (Coursebook 102-bet, 16a-dialog:
     'You should see an optician.')

 2  Ko'chaga axlat tashlash — ZARARLI
    → SHOULDN'T.
    (Coursebook 99-bet, varaqa)

 3  KALIT: 'IT'S COLD outside' — sovuqda
    qalin kiyim FOYDALI → SHOULD.
    (Grammar 62-bet, 8-mashqning 1-bandi:
     'It's cold. You mustn't leave without
      your jacket.')

 4  Ko'chadan o'tishdan oldin qarash —
    XAVFSIZLIK choralari → SHOULD.

 5  To'la oshqozon bilan suzish — XAVFLI
    → SHOULDN'T.
    (Coursebook 103-bet, 17b:
     'It is dangerous to swim with a full
      stomach.')

 6  KALIT: 'TO LOSE WEIGHT' — maqsad
    IJOBIY → SHOULD.

 7  Keksalarga o'rin berish — ODOBLI ish
    → SHOULD.

 8  Notanish odamlar bilan gaplashish —
    bolalar uchun XAVFLI → SHOULDN'T.


DIQQAT — 'PUT ON' AJRALADIGAN FE'L:
  'PUT ON a heavy jacket'  ✓
  'PUT a heavy jacket ON'  ✓
  'PUT IT ON'              ✓
  'PUT ON IT'              ✗

  Coursebook 101-bet, 9b: 'Put a jumper on.'


DIQQAT — 'BEFORE CROSSING':
  'before CROSSING the street'
  Predlogdan keyin fe'l -ING oladi.

  Yana: 'after EATING' (5-band)


DIQQAT — 'LOOK BOTH WAYS':
  'both ways' = ikki tomonga (chapga va o'ngga)
  'a way' bu yerda = tomon, yo'nalish.


DIQQAT — 'JOIN A GYM':
  'to JOIN a gym/club/team' = a'zo bo'lmoq,
  yozilmoq
  ('to enter a gym' — shunchaki ichkariga
   kirish)

  'to LOSE WEIGHT' = vazn tashlamoq
  (lose → LOST)
  Teskarisi: 'to PUT ON weight' = semirmoq


DIQQAT — 'GIVE YOUR SEAT TO':
  'give something TO somebody' — predlog 'to'.
  'older people' = keksalar
  ('old people' ham to'g'ri, lekin 'older'
   odobliroq).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an optician    = ko'zoynak ustasi
  litter         = axlat
  heavy          = qalin, og'ir
  both ways      = ikki tomonga
  to cross       = kesib o'tmoq
  a meal         = ovqat (bir mahal)
  to join a gym  = sport zaliga yozilmoq
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  a seat         = o'rindiq, joy
  older people   = keksalar
  a stranger     = notanish odam

items.sentence: 1  Kevin has a problem with his eyes. He ................ see an optician.
items.uz: Kevinning ko'zi bilan muammo bor. U ko'zoynak ustasiga borishi kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'a PROBLEM with his eyes' — muammo bor,
demak YORDAM kerak → SHOULD.

Coursebook 102-bet, 16a-dialog AYNAN shu:
'I can't see that sign very well.'
'You SHOULD see an optician.'

'to SEE an optician' = qabuliga bormoq.

items.sentence: 2  People ........................... drop litter in the streets.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Ko'chaga axlat tashlash — ZARARLI → SHOULDN'T.

Coursebook 99-bet, varaqa:
'Do not DROP rubbish in the street.
It looks and smells horrible.'

Grammar 60-bet: 'You shouldn't drop rubbish
in the street.'

items.sentence: 3  It's cold outside. You ......................... put on a heavy jacket.
items.uz: Tashqarida sovuq. Qalin kurtka kiyishingiz kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'IT'S COLD outside' — sovuqda qalin
kiyim FOYDALI → SHOULD.

'PUT ON' — ajraladigan fe'l:
  put on a jacket = put a jacket on ✓
  put IT on ✓ / put on IT ✗

Coursebook 101-bet, 9b: 'Put a jumper on.'
'heavy' bu yerda = qalin (kiyim haqida).

items.sentence: 4  You ..................... look both ways before crossing the street.
items.uz: Ko'chadan o'tishdan oldin ikki tomonga qarashingiz kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Ko'chadan o'tishdan oldin qarash —
XAVFSIZLIK chorasi, FOYDALI → SHOULD.

'both ways' = ikki tomonga (chap va o'ng).

'before CROSSING' — predlogdan keyin -ING
(Coursebook 100-bet: 'before smoking').

items.sentence: 5  You ......................... swim after eating a big meal.
items.uz: Ko'p ovqat yegandan keyin suzmasligingiz kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
To'la oshqozon bilan suzish — XAVFLI
→ SHOULDN'T.

Coursebook 103-bet, 17b-mashq:
'Never swim after eating.'
'It is dangerous to swim with a full stomach.'

'after EATING' — predlogdan keyin -ING.
'a meal' = bir mahal ovqat.

items.sentence: 6  Michael ......................... join a gym to lose weight.
items.uz: Maykl vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga yozilishi kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'TO LOSE WEIGHT' — maqsad IJOBIY
(sog'liq uchun) → SHOULD.

DIQQAT: ega 'MICHAEL' (III shaxs birlik)
bo'lsa ham 'should' O'ZGARMAYDI.

'to JOIN a gym' = sport zaliga yozilmoq.
'to LOSE weight' = vazn tashlamoq
(teskarisi: 'to PUT ON weight' = semirmoq).

items.sentence: 7  When you are on a bus you ......................... give your seat to older people.
items.uz: Avtobusda bo'lganingizda o'rningizni keksalarga berishingiz kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Keksalarga o'rin berish — ODOBLI, FOYDALI ish
→ SHOULD.

'give something TO somebody' — predlog 'to'.
'ON a bus' — avtobusda (predlog 'on').
'older people' = keksalar ('old people' dan
odobliroq).

items.uz: Bolalar notanish odamlar bilan gaplashmasligi kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Notanish odamlar bilan gaplashish — bolalar
uchun XAVFLI → SHOULDN'T.

'talk TO somebody' — predlog 'to'.
'a stranger' = notanish odam
(strange = g'alati, notanish).

Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
'don't tell jokes to people you don't know
very well'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the leaflet below giving advice to dog owners and make sentences using should or shouldn't, as in the example. — HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR DOG
exercises.instructionUz: It egalariga maslahat beruvchi quyidagi varaqani o'qing va namunadagidek should yoki shouldn't bilan gap tuzing. — ITINGIZNI QANDAY PARVARISH QILISH KERAK
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHA:
  'HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR DOG'
  (Itingizni qanday parvarish qilish kerak)

BESH BAND, HAR BIRIDA RASM va BELGI:
  ✓ = SHOULD    (qilish kerak)
  ✗ = SHOULDN'T (qilmaslik kerak)

  Ya'ni BELGI javobni AYTIB TURIBDI —
  taxmin kerak emas!


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  ✓ take/for a walk three times a day
    → You SHOULD take your dog for a walk
      three times a day.
      (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  ✗ keep/cage
    → You SHOULDN'T keep your dog in a cage.

 3  ✓ feed/once a day
    → You SHOULD feed your dog once a day.

 4  ✓ wash/once a week
    → You SHOULD wash your dog once a week.

 5  ✗ leave/at home alone
    → You SHOULDN'T leave your dog at home
      alone.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Itingizni kuniga uch marta sayrga olib
    chiqishingiz kerak.
 2  Itingizni qafasda saqlamasligingiz kerak.
 3  Itingizni kuniga bir marta
    ovqatlantirishingiz kerak.
 4  Itingizni haftada bir marta
    yuvishingiz kerak.
 5  Itingizni uyda yolg'iz
    qoldirmasligingiz kerak.


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:
  1  It sayr uchun tayyor, arqonni tishlab
     turibdi
  2  It QAFASDA (panjara ortida), g'amgin
  3  It kosasi yonida o'tiribdi
  4  It TOG'ORAda yuvinyapti
  5  It 'FIDO' yozuvli budkasida YOLG'IZ


QISQARTMA ShAKLNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  Kitob chiziqcha bilan qisqa ko'rsatma
  bergan. To'liq gapda EGALIK olmoshi va
  PREDLOG qo'shiladi:

     take/for a walk
       → take YOUR DOG for a walk

     keep/cage
       → keep YOUR DOG IN A cage

     feed/once a day
       → feed YOUR DOG once a day

     wash/once a week
       → wash YOUR DOG once a week

     leave/at home alone
       → leave YOUR DOG at home alone

  DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA PREDLOG QO'ShILADI:
  'keep/cage' → 'keep your dog IN A cage'
  Bu — eng ko'p unutiladigan joy.


GRAMMAR 61-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda AYNAN shunday mashq bor edi, lekin
  MUShUK haqida:
     'HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR CAT'
     feed/twice a day, leave/outside,
     take/to the vet, forget/to fill water
     bowl, empty/litter tray

  Bu yerda IT haqida.
  Farqlar qiziq:
     mushuk — kuniga IKKI marta ovqat
     it     — kuniga BIR marta ovqat


TAKRORLANISh IBORALARI:
  three times a day = kuniga uch marta
  once a day        = kuniga bir marta
  once a week       = haftada bir marta

  DIQQAT:
     once  (bir marta) — 'one time' emas
     twice (ikki marta) — 'two times' emas
     three TIMES (uch marta) — uchdan boshlab
                              'times'


DIQQAT — 'TAKE FOR A WALK':
  'to take somebody FOR A WALK' = sayrga olib
  chiqmoq (turg'un ibora)

  'to GO for a walk' = sayr qilmoq
  'to TAKE somebody for a walk' = birovni
  sayrga olib chiqmoq


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE ... ALONE':
  'leave your dog at home ALONE' = uyda
  YOLG'IZ qoldirmoq

  'alone' — sifat/ravish (yolg'iz).
  DIQQAT: 'lonely' — BOSHQA ma'no
  (yolg'izlikdan qiynalgan).

  Coursebook 100-bet, Yaponiya matni:
  'find a place where you can do it ALONE'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a dog owner   = it egasi
  to take care of = parvarish qilmoq
  to take for a walk = sayrga olib chiqmoq
  a cage        = qafas
  to feed       = ovqatlantirmoq
  to wash       = yuvmoq
  to leave alone = yolg'iz qoldirmoq
  three times a day = kuniga uch marta

points.en: 1  ✓ take/for a walk three times a day  →  You should take your dog for a walk three times a day.
points.uz: Itingizni kuniga uch marta sayrga olib chiqishingiz kerak.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
✓ belgisi → SHOULD.
'take somebody FOR A WALK' — turg'un ibora.

points.en: 2  ✗ keep/cage  →  You shouldn't keep your dog in a cage.
points.noteUz:
✗ belgisi → SHOULDN'T.

DIQQAT — PREDLOG QO'SHILADI:
'keep/cage' → 'keep your dog IN A cage'.
Bu — eng ko'p unutiladigan joy.

'a cage' = qafas.

points.en: 3  ✓ feed/once a day  →  You should feed your dog once a day.
points.uz: Itingizni kuniga bir marta ovqatlantirishingiz kerak.
points.noteUz:
✓ belgisi → SHOULD.
'once a day' = kuniga bir marta.

DIQQAT: Grammar 61-betdagi MUSHUK mashqida
'TWICE a day' edi — it va mushuk boshqacha
ovqatlantiriladi.

points.en: 4  ✓ wash/once a week  →  You should wash your dog once a week.
points.uz: Itingizni haftada bir marta yuvishingiz kerak.
points.noteUz:
✓ belgisi → SHOULD.
'once a week' = haftada bir marta.

Rasmda it tog'orada yuvinyapti.

points.en: 5  ✗ leave/at home alone  →  You shouldn't leave your dog at home alone.
points.noteUz:
✗ belgisi → SHOULDN'T.

'leave ... ALONE' = yolg'iz qoldirmoq.
leave → LEFT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

DIQQAT: 'alone' = yolg'iz (holat);
'lonely' = yolg'izlikdan qiynalgan (his).

Rasmda it budkasida yolg'iz.

PREDLOG qo'shiladi:
